messages.en:
I know you went to a lot
of trouble to send me
that letter, but I don't
get it. Now I'm so sad!
messages.et:
Tean, et nägid palju vaeva,
et mulle see kiri saata,
aga ma ei saa sellest aru.
Nüüd olen nii kurb!

messages.en:
That was such a hard
letter to read. I think I
might be kind of stupid
or... I just don't know!
messages.et:
See kiri oli nii raske
lugeda. Arvan, et ma olen
vist natuke rumal või...
Ma lihtsalt ei tea!

messages.en:
Is it fun for you to write
letters that you know I
can't read? It makes me
really sad, you know.
messages.et:
Kas sul on lõbus kirjutada
kirju, mida sa tead, et ma
lugeda ei oska? See teeb
mind tõesti kurvaks, tead.
